corrected_fields.summary: This academic paper studies how heat-related policies affect internal migration across U.S. counties. The researchers analyzed 4,713 heat policies and found that heat adaptation policies (APs) reduce out-migration while heat mitigation policies (MPs) increase it, with heterogeneous effects based on policy type and demographic factors.
